visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a vintage-style wooden sign with Chinese characters for an ice cream shop under bright studio lighting. (2) Behind-the-scenes perspective showing professional film cameras, lighting rigs, and crew members focusing on a man in a denim jacket and a woman in white winter-style clothing on a retro street set. (3) The main characters, a male and two females, stand in front of the set, waving and smiling directly at the camera while speaking with high energy. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor interview setting with wooden bookshelves in the background; the female leads take turns speaking with bright expressions. (5) Quick montage showing the actors on set eating shaved ice from a wooden table, taking selfies with a smartphone, and engaging in lighthearted interaction with the crew. (6) Visual phase shifts to an outdoor traditional brick-walled courtyard where the three main actors are performing a synchronized dance routine. (7) Return to the indoor interview setting where the male lead speaks while gesturing with his hands. (8) Scene transitions to a nighttime urban setting with neon signs and large crowds; the actors lead a massive group dance in a busy square. (9) Close-up shots of the actors making cute faces and pointing at the camera as the nighttime dance concludes. (10) Final graphical sequence showing the game logo with animated ice and snow effects.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 3 main creators (Ken, Meng Jie, Mimi), approximately 10 production crew members, and 30+ dancers in the final scene.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged man in a denim shirt and blue bandana; two young women in white furry winter-themed outfits with bows and short skirts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Sets include a retro Japanese-style ice cream shop, a vintage library room, a traditional red-brick alleyway, and a busy modern city intersection with bright LED billboards.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, upbeat dance-pop track featuring strong synthetic bass and electronic percussion. (2) A male voice enters with a high-arousal shout, followed by two female voices cheering; the mix is clean and professional. (3) Transition to dialogue where the speakers maintain a friendly and excited tone, their voices positioned clearly above the music bed. (4) Distinct camera shutter clicks are heard layered over the persistent electronic music rhythm during a filming montage. (5) A female voice speaks in Korean with a polite and melodic cadence, followed by immediate Chinese narration from the male lead. (6) The music swells into a chorus with rhythmic vocals and cheers as the audio reaches peak energy during the group dance sequence. (7) Final phase features a digital ice-cracking sound effect and a quick whoosh transition as the BGM fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Behind-the-scenes Interviews -> Climax Group Dance -> Call-to-action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the mobile game 'Whiteout Survival' by showcasing a high-energy behind-the-scenes look at the commercial shoot featuring celebrity Ken and popular cheerleaders, emphasizing the fun atmosphere and group participation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly features the game logo, characters, and the title 'Whiteout Survival' throughout, and ends with a 'Play Now' CTA.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production-value promotional montage using influencers to leverage the social-viral appeal of synchronized dancing.
